name: 0026 - sage rounded-square holder
summary: An open-top, handleless, pale sage green holder with a rounded square footprint, softly rounded rim, slightly tapered straight walls and a closed interior floor. Reconstructed from IMG_0026.mov for Kuafu simulation.
assumptions: Reconstructed by the interactive assistant from 16 sampled video frames; no external model API request was made.
Monocular video supplies no known metric reference. The outside width and depth are assumed to be approximately 80 mm; all dimensions remain uncalibrated estimates, not measurements.
Square footprint and fourfold symmetry are inferred from the high-angle views at 2.0-2.9 seconds. The nominal height-to-width ratio is 1.4.
Material is modeled as opaque pale sage plastic with moderate roughness. Color is an approximate unlit albedo, not a recovered texture or calibrated material.
Mass, density and friction cannot be established from the video. Dynamic mass remains a provisional 0.2 kg and friction a provisional 0.5.
The underside is not visible. A flat closed bottom is inferred from the visible interior floor and stable contact with the tabletop; its thickness is assumed.
The dark contact line is represented by the rounded base and its shadow; a separate rubber foot is not established by the video.
Minor marks in the interior floor are omitted from contact geometry. No drainage hole is visible.
Collision geometry preserves the cavity with a base and 16 convex wall pieces. Small rim/base fillets are simplified in the colliders.
